senses.gloss: m. (preced.) planter, gardener (with the right of tenancy, v. אָרִיס).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 109a:9-13">B. Mets. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>רב</he> … <he>ההוא ש׳ וכ׳</he> Rab Joseph had a certain gardener (on his farm).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 109a:9-13">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 21b:3">B. Bath. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>מקרי … ש׳ וכ׳</he> a primary teacher, a gardener, … are all considered as forewarned (may be discharged without notice); a. fr.
